page: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores via an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor operating at 3.9 GHz, accompanied by 480 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 512 GB of DDR5 operating at 7 GHz, delivering an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. The platform features a baseline network throughput of 15 Gbps and includes instruction sets such as Intel AMX and AVX-512. It contains no bundled local storage and no discrete GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-threaded compute and data-retrieval performance. The instance registers top-tier results in Clang software compilation, image processing, and static web serving throughput at 103.58 GB/sec. Memory subsystem profiling shows read bandwidth of 5122.92 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 192.31 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. In transactional benchmarks, the server produces 113.45 million Redis SET operations per second along with strong PassMark database marks. Natural language inference tests show high token processing speeds on small models utilizing matrix extensions, while large model generation falls within median ranges.

The primary tradeoff of the flex profile stems from its burstable CPU allocation, which makes it less appropriate for sustained, uninterrupted maximum compute usage compared to dedicated core tiers. Furthermore, storage requirements must be handled entirely over the network due to the lack of onboard NVMe drives. In return, the instance offers favorable resource density for memory-bound tasks that experience varying CPU utilization. It is structurally aligned with in-memory caching tiers, Redis deployments, relational databases with large buffer pools, and high-memory ETL batch jobs.
description: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance based on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, featuring 64 burstable vCPUs across 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor clocked at 3.9 GHz. The architecture incorporates 512 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory, delivering an 8 GB per vCPU allocation, and includes a 480 MB L3 cache alongside hardware support for Intel AMX and AVX-512 extensions. The server does not bundle local storage, relying on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network throughput of 15 Gbps without dedicated GPUs. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-decile static web serving throughput and software compilation speeds, supported by high multi-core execution metrics and memory bandwidth. The balance of high RAM density and burstable compute capacity provides cost-effective efficiency for memory-heavy environments. The r8i-flex.16xlarge is engineered for in-memory data stores, Redis caching tiers, large-scale database operations, and enterprise data processing workloads.
